notes: Paper constrains oscillating massive scalar field dark matter via Rb/Cs hyperfine frequency ratio. Primary result is a mass-dependent coupling limit on the linear combination d_e + 0.043(d_m̂ - d_g), where d_e couples to electromagnetism (fine structure constant α), d_m̂ to quark mass, and d_g to QCD scale. Classified as ScalarPhoton because the dominant constraint is on d_e (coupling to α), with the paper stating that when only d_e ≠ 0 is assumed, limits improve Dy results by >1 order of magnitude. The coupling convention reflects the actual linear combination constrained. Data points extracted from Fig. 3: most stringent limit 3.8×10^-9 at m_ϕ = 1.4×10^-23 eV, flat bound ~5.3×10^-4 across lower masses, and approximate intermediate value. DM density of 0.4 GeV/cm³ is the galactic value used in Eq. (8) to relate oscillation amplitude to coupling.
